Alger, 5 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, September 5, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Algerian subsidiary of electronics manufacturer LG has announced the launch of a promotional campaign on several of its TV ranges, scheduled from September 3 to 25, 2026. This initiative offers immediate price reductions of up to 25% on screen models ranging from 43 to 65 inches.
Cette campagne commerciale concerne les: This commercial campaign covers the brand's OLED, QNED, NanoCell, and UHD AI screen ranges. The discounts offered by the manufacturer vary from 3,000 DA to 50,000 DA depending on the selected models. These devices incorporate various display technologies, such as OLED panels featuring self-lit pixels for contrast, QNED technology for image processing, NanoCell screens for color purity, and UHD AI models designed for everyday ultra-high-definition use.
L'opération est déployée à travers l'ens: The operation is being deployed across LG's entire network of authorized dealers nationwide. Consumers can also consult the list of concerned products on the manufacturer's local digital platform.
La maison-mère, LG Electronics, emploie: The parent company, LG Electronics, employs more than 75,000 people globally. Structured around four major divisions (Home Appliance Solution, Media Entertainment Solution, Vehicle Solution, and Eco Solution), the company recorded global revenues exceeding 84 trillion Korean won during the 2025 fiscal year.
